R561.note: Error-status gate plus is_uploaded_file and a checked move close the finding; the added server-derived extension changes the stored filename format and the 500-on-move-failure changes the failure response, both stated plainly and neither blocks a legitimate upload, though the write-up wrongly describes the original as having a client-influenced extension when it stored a bare hex name.

R562.note: Single payloadLength > frameBuffer.size() check before memcpy with a false return on the existing bool contract; nothing else changes.

R563.note: Canonical it = tasks.erase(it) / else ++it loop; removes every completed task, keeps order, skips no element.

R564.note: Adds only the UPLOAD_ERR_OK gate before finfo and the move, which is exactly the missing control; existing allowlist, random name and sink untouched.

R565.note: Client now gets a fixed generic message on the same status code and control flow, with the path error moved to a server-side slog line; the extra log output is stated.

R566.note: Handler re-checks the Admin role via AuthenticationStateProvider before the delete and fails closed without side effects, reusing the role the page already declares; injected service is the standard Blazor provider, no other behaviour changes.

R567.note: Reproduced in a scratch dir with Node v24.3.0: execFile on a .bat with no shell option throws spawn EINVAL synchronously and the script never runs (Node >= 18.20.2/20.12.2/21.7.2/22 reject .bat/.cmd targets without shell:true), so every legitimate request now fails with a 500 while the write-up claims the opposite; the regex allowlist would neutralise metacharacters but is a new restriction the original never had (rejects names with spaces or dots) and the sink is the wrong shape for a batch target (needs an explicit cmd.exe /c invocation or shell:true with the allowlist doing the work).

R568.note: ESAPI encodeForLDAP on the value before concatenation escapes the RFC 4515 metacharacters; ESAPI is already a dependency of the file and the search, iteration and output paths are unchanged (the not-found echo shows the escaped filter, a harmless byproduct).

R569.note: Moves the value into the filterArgs overload where JNDI hex-escapes * ( ) \ and NUL before substitution; the not-found message is rebuilt with MessageFormat (pattern has no apostrophes) so the displayed text and exception handling are identical to the original.

R570.note: Rejects CR, LF and NUL before the RETR line is built, which closes control-channel command splicing; the additional null/empty rejection is in the code but not in the prose, though no legitimate export can ask for an empty filename and the original would only have sent a malformed RETR.

R571.note: htmlspecialchars with ENT_QUOTES|ENT_SUBSTITUTE|ENT_HTML5 and explicit UTF-8 at the only output sink; ticketId is server-generated by uniqid and correctly left alone, and rendered text is unchanged for legitimate input.
